description: Are China and the United States shaping the same AI future, or diverging down different paths? Having worked in both ecosystems, Alex Lamb shares his perspective from Tsinghua University. Together with RoundTable's Yushun, they explore how AI tools and agents are transforming how students learn and code. From data bottlenecks to real-world robots, and a shifting job market, what skills will matter most and how can we stay future-ready?
classificationReason: 主题主要是中美 AI 发展与工具、智能体和教育，包含数据瓶颈及现实机器人讨论。
qualityReason: 基于跨生态经验的专家访谈与分析，元数据显示讨论范围广且可能具有原创深度。
